task1.title: Advertising staff qualifications
task1.prompt: The charts below show the qualifications of staff in an advertising company in 1990 and 2010.

chartDesc.title: Qualifications of staff in an advertising company in 1990 and 2010
chartDesc.overview: Overall, staff qualifications shifted toward higher postgraduate degrees between the two periods. While Master's degrees remained the most stable category, PhDs grew significantly (especially in Science), while First Degrees saw a notable decline.
unreadable: The header text above the second pie chart is printed as '1990' despite representing 2010 per the prompt context.
keyFeatures: From the first chart (1990), Master - Science was the largest category at 29%, followed by Master - Art at 21% and First Degree - Science at 20%.
In the first chart (1990), PhD - Art held the smallest share at only 2%, while PhD - Science made up 13%.
In the second chart, PhD - Science became the single largest category, rising to 30%, and PhD - Art rose to 5%.
First Degrees dropped significantly in the second chart: First Degree - Art fell from 15% to 2%, and First Degree - Science fell from 20% to 11%.
Master - Science remained identical at 29% in both charts, while Master - Art rose slightly from 21% to 23%.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparison where relevant.
task1.sampleBand5:
The two pie charts show information about the staff qualifications at an advertising company. They show the years 1990 and 2010.

In 1990, most people had a degree, with 55%. Those with a professional qualification were 30%. The smallest number had no qualification, which was 15%.

Looking at 2010, the percentage of staff with a degree was a lot less, only 35%. But the number of people with a professional qualification went up to 45%. The amount of people with no qualification also increased. It went up to 20%. It is clear that more people had professional qualifications in 2010 than in 1990. The proportion of people with degrees went down.

Overall, the charts show a change in the qualifications of staff over the twenty years.
task1.sampleBand6:
The pie charts give information about the different qualifications held by staff working at an advertising company in the years 1990 and 2010.

Overall, what is immediately clear is that the proportion of staff with university degrees increased significantly over the period, while the percentage of those with no qualifications decreased. Also, the proportion of staff with professional qualifications saw a decline.

In 1990, just 30% of staff held a university degree. This increased to 45% in 2010. Staff with no qualifications accounted for 40% of the total in 1990, but this figure fell to 25% twenty years later. Regarding staff with professional qualifications, there was a decrease from 20% in 1990 to 15% in 2010. The number of staff with other qualifications remained stable at 10% in both years.

In conclusion, there was a shift towards a more highly educated workforce in the advertising company between 1990 and 2010.
task1.sampleBand7:
The pie charts illustrate the proportion of staff with different qualifications working in an advertising company in the years 1990 and 2010.

Overall, the most striking feature is that the company employed a significantly larger percentage of staff holding a postgraduate degree in 2010 compared to 1990. Conversely, the proportion of staff with no qualifications decreased substantially over the same period. It is also noticeable that the percentage of staff with a first degree remained relatively stable.

In 1990, the largest group of employees, at 45%, had no qualifications. Those holding a first degree accounted for 33% of the workforce, while staff with a postgraduate qualification made up only 12%. The remaining 10% possessed a diploma. By 2010, however, the composition of the staff had changed considerably. The percentage of employees with no qualifications had fallen sharply to just 5%. Staff holding a postgraduate degree had risen dramatically to 40%, becoming the largest single group. There was only a slight increase in the percentage of staff with a first degree, to 35%, while those with a diploma increased to 20%. This suggests a shift in the company's hiring practices towards more highly qualified individuals.
task1.sampleBand8:
The charts illustrate the proportion of employees with varying levels of academic qualifications working for an advertising company in the years 1990 and 2010.

Overall, the data reveals a marked shift towards a more highly educated workforce over the two decades. While the percentage of staff with only a high school education or no qualifications decreased substantially, the proportion of those holding bachelor's or postgraduate degrees experienced considerable growth.

In 1990, the largest segment of the workforce (40%) possessed only a high school qualification, while those with no qualifications accounted for 15%. In contrast, employees with a bachelor's degree constituted 30%, and those with a postgraduate degree represented a mere 15%. By 2010, the landscape had changed significantly. The percentage of staff with high school diplomas had plummeted to 10%, and those with no qualifications were negligible. Conversely, the proportion of employees holding a bachelor's degree had risen to 45%, and the percentage with postgraduate degrees had more than doubled, reaching 45%. This highlights a clear trend towards a workforce with advanced academic credentials. The company clearly prioritised higher education in its hiring practices in 2010.
task1.sampleBand9:

Overall, the data reveals a significant shift towards a more highly educated workforce over the two decades. While staff with no qualifications or only a high school diploma constituted a considerable proportion in 1990, their numbers dwindled substantially by 2010. Conversely, the proportion of employees holding bachelor's and postgraduate degrees experienced a marked increase.

task1.sampleAnswer:
The pie charts compare the educational qualifications of employees at an advertising company in 1990 and 2010. Overall, there was a significant shift toward higher educational attainment over the twenty-year period.

In 1990, the workforce was predominantly made up of staff with lower-level qualifications. Those with no formal qualifications accounted for the largest proportion at approximately 35%, while employees with only school-leaving certificates comprised around 30%. Workers holding diplomas represented about 20% of the staff, and university graduates made up the smallest group at roughly 15%.

By 2010, this pattern had changed dramatically. University degree holders had become the dominant group, representing approximately 40% of all employees. Diploma holders also increased their share to about 25%. In contrast, the proportion of staff with no qualifications fell sharply to just 10%, and those with only school certificates decreased to around 25%.

The data reveals a clear trend toward a more highly educated workforce in the advertising industry, likely reflecting both increased competition for jobs and the growing complexity of the field requiring higher qualifications.

Ikkita doiraviy diagramma reklama kompaniyasidagi xodimlarning malakasi haqida ma'lumot beradi. Ular 1990 va 2010 yillarni ko'rsatadi.

1990-yilda ko'pchilik odamlar diplomga ega bo'lgan, bu 55% ni tashkil etgan. Kasbiy malakaga ega bo'lganlar 30% edi. Eng kam soni hech qanday malakaga ega bo'lmaganlar edi, bu 15% edi.

2010-yilga nazar tashlasak, diplomga ega xodimlarning foizi ancha kamroq edi, atigi 35%. Ammo kasbiy malakaga ega bo'lgan odamlarning soni 45% gacha ko'tarildi. Hech qanday malakaga ega bo'lmagan odamlarning soni ham oshdi. U 20% gacha ko'tarildi. Shu narsa aniqki, 2010-yilda 1990-yilga nisbatan ko'proq odam kasbiy malakaga ega bo'lgan. Diplomga ega odamlarning ulushi kamaydi.

Umuman olganda, diagrammalar yigirma yil davomida xodimlarning malakasidagi o'zgarishni ko'rsatadi.

Doira diagrammalar reklama kompaniyasida ishlaydigan xodimlarning 1990 va 2010-yillardagi turli malakalariga oid ma'lumot beradi.

Umuman olganda, darhol ko'zga tashlanadigan narsa shundaki, universitet diplomiga ega xodimlar ulushi vaqt o'tishi bilan sezilarli darajada oshdi, malakasi bo'lmaganlar foizi esa kamaydi. Shuningdek, professional malakaga ega xodimlar ulushi ham pasaygan.

1990-yilda xodimlarning atigi 30 foizi universitet diplomiga ega bo'lgan. Bu ko'rsatkich 2010-yilda 45 foizga ko'tarildi. Malakasi bo'lmagan xodimlar 1990-yilda umumiy xodimlarning 40 foizini tashkil etdi, ammo bu ko'rsatkich yigirma yil o'tib 25 foizga tushdi. Professional malakaga ega xodimlarga kelsak, 1990-yildagi 20 foizdan 2010-yilda 15 foizga pasayish kuzatildi. Boshqa malakalarga ega xodimlar soni har ikki yilda ham 10 foizda barqaror qoldi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, 1990-yildan 2010-yilgacha reklama kompaniyasida yuqori ma'lumotli ishchi kuchiga o'tish kuzatildi.
task1.uzSampleBand7:
Doira diagrammalar 1990 va 2010-yillarda reklama kompaniyasida ishlaydigan turli malakaga ega xodimlarning nisbatini ko'rsatadi.

Umuman olganda, eng ajralib turadigan jihati shundaki, kompaniya 2010-yilda 1990-yilga nisbatan aspirantura darajasiga ega bo'lgan xodimlarning sezilarli darajada yuqori foizini ish bilan ta'minlagan. Aksincha, hech qanday malakaga ega bo'lmagan xodimlarning ulushi shu davrda sezilarli darajada kamaydi. Shuni ham ta'kidlash joizki, birinchi darajaga ega bo'lgan xodimlarning foizi nisbatan barqaror bo'lib qoldi.

1990-yilda eng katta xodimlar guruhi, 45% hech qanday malakaga ega emas edi. Birinchi darajaga ega bo'lganlar ishchi kuchining 33% ni tashkil etdi, aspirantura malakasiga ega bo'lgan xodimlar esa atigi 12% ni tashkil etdi. Qolgan 10% diplomga ega edi. Ammo, 2010-yilga kelib, xodimlarning tarkibi ancha o'zgardi. Hech qanday malakaga ega bo'lmagan xodimlarning foizi keskin pasayib, atigi 5% ni tashkil etdi. Aspirantura darajasiga ega bo'lgan xodimlar keskin o'sdi va 40% ni tashkil etib, eng katta guruhga aylandi. Birinchi darajaga ega bo'lgan xodimlarning foizida ozgina o'sish kuzatildi va 35% ni tashkil etdi, diplomga ega bo'lganlar esa 20% gacha ko'paydi. Bu kompaniyaning yollash amaliyotida yuqori malakali shaxslarga qaratilgan o'zgarishni ko'rsatadi.
task1.uzSampleBand8:
Diagrammalar 1990 va 2010-yillarda reklama kompaniyasida ishlaydigan, turli darajadagi akademik malakaga ega bo'lgan xodimlarning nisbatini ko'rsatadi.

Umuman olganda, ma'lumotlar ikki o'n yillik davomida yanada yuqori ma'lumotli ishchi kuchiga sezilarli o'zgarishni ko'rsatadi. Faqat o'rta maktab ma'lumotiga ega yoki hech qanday malakaga ega bo'lmagan xodimlar foizi sezilarli darajada kamaygan bo'lsa-da, bakalavr yoki aspirantura darajasiga ega bo'lganlarning ulushi ancha o'sishni boshdan kechirdi.

1990-yilda ishchi kuchining eng katta qismi (40%) faqat o'rta maktab ma'lumotiga ega bo'lgan bo'lsa, hech qanday malakaga ega bo'lmaganlar 15% ni tashkil etdi. Aksincha, bakalavr darajasiga ega bo'lgan xodimlar 30% ni, aspirantura darajasiga ega bo'lganlar esa atigi 15%ni tashkil etdi. 2010-yilga kelib, vaziyat sezilarli darajada o'zgardi. O'rta maktab diplomiga ega bo'lgan xodimlar foizi 10% gacha keskin tushib ketdi, hech qanday malakaga ega bo'lmaganlar esa ahamiyatsiz edi. Aksincha, bakalavr darajasiga ega bo'lgan xodimlar ulushi 45% gacha ko'tarildi va aspirantura darajasiga ega bo'lganlar foizi ikki barobardan ko'proqqa oshdi, 45% ga yetdi. Bu rivojlangan akademik ma'lumotga ega bo'lgan ishchi kuchiga aniq tendentsiyani ko'rsatadi. Kompaniya 2010-yilda ishga qabul qilish amaliyotida oliy ma'lumotga ustunlik berdi.

Diagrammalar 1990 va 2010-yillarda reklama firmasidagi xodimlar o'rtasida akademik malakalarning taqsimotini ko'rsatadi.

Umuman olganda, ma'lumotlar ikki o'n yillik davomida yanada yuqori ma'lumotli ishchi kuchiga tomon sezilarli o'zgarishni ko'rsatadi. 1990-yilda hech qanday malakaga ega bo'lmagan yoki faqat o'rta maktab diplomiga ega bo'lgan xodimlar sezilarli qismni tashkil etgan bo'lsa, 2010-yilga kelib ularning soni sezilarli darajada kamaydi. Aksincha, bakalavr va aspirantura darajasiga ega bo'lgan xodimlar ulushi sezilarli o'sishni boshdan kechirdi.

1990-yilda reklama kompaniyasi xodimlarining eng katta qismi, 30% hech qanday malakaga ega emas edi. O'rta maktab diplomiga ega bo'lganlar keyingi eng katta guruhni tashkil etib, 28% ni tashkil etdi. Bakalavr darajasiga ega bo'lgan xodimlar ishchi kuchining 25% ni tashkil etdi, aspirantura malakasiga ega bo'lganlar esa nisbatan kichik ulushni - 17% ni tashkil etdi. Biroq, 2010-yilga kelib, vaziyat keskin o'zgardi. Hech qanday malakaga ega bo'lmagan xodimlarning foizi faqatgina 5% ga tushib ketdi, o'rta maktab diplomiga ega bo'lganlar esa 12% gacha kamaydi. Bunga keskin zid ravishda, bakalavr darajasiga ega bo'lganlar ulushi 40% gacha ko'tarilib, eng katta guruhga aylandi. Bundan tashqari, aspirantura darajasiga ega bo'lgan xodimlar foizi ikki barobardan ko'proq oshdi, 43% ga yetdi va ikkinchi eng katta malaka guruhiga aylandi. Bu yanada ma'lumotli ishchi kuchiga qaratilgan aniq tendentsiyani ko'rsatadi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, ma'lumotlar reklama kompaniyasi ichida oliy ta'limga aniq sarmoya kiritilganligini ko'rsatadi, natijada 1990 va 2010-yillar oralig'ida uning xodimlarining malakasi sezilarli darajada oshdi.

task2.title: Hosting international sports events
task2.prompt: Some people think that hosting an international sports event is good for the country, while some people think it is bad. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
task2.instruction: Discuss both views and give your opinion.
task2.sampleBand5:
Many countries want to host international sports events like the Olympics or the World Cup. Some people think this is a good thing, but others think it is not. This essay will talk about both sides and my opinion too.

On the one hand, having a big sports event can be good for a country. It can bring in lots of tourists, and they spend money in the country. This helps businesses like hotels and restaurants. Also, the government might build new stadiums and roads, which can be used by people even after the event is over. It can also make people happy and proud of their country.

However, there are also problems with hosting these events. It can cost a lot of money to build everything that is needed. Sometimes, the government has to borrow money, and then the country has debt. Also, some people might have to move from their homes to make way for the new stadiums. This is not fair to them. The security also needs to be very tight, which costs even more money.

In conclusion, there are good and bad things about hosting big sports events. While it can bring money and make people happy, it can also be very expensive and cause problems for some people. I think it depends on the country and if they can really afford it. If they can, then it might be a good idea, but if they can’t, it is probably better to not do it.
task2.sampleBand6:
Hosting international sports events, like the Olympics or the World Cup, is a topic of debate. Some people believe that these events bring many benefits to the host country, while others argue that the disadvantages outweigh the advantages. In this essay, I will discuss both sides of the argument and then give my opinion.

On the one hand, there are several reasons why hosting a major sports event can be beneficial. Firstly, it can boost the economy. The influx of tourists can lead to increased spending in hotels, restaurants, and shops. Also, there is often a need to build new infrastructure, such as stadiums and transportation systems, which creates jobs and can improve the country's overall infrastructure in the long run. Secondly, these events can raise the country's profile on the international stage. This can attract foreign investment and improve the country's image. Finally, hosting such an event can inspire national pride and unity.

However, there are also arguments against hosting international sports events. One major concern is the cost. Building new facilities and providing security can be very expensive, and sometimes the costs outweigh the economic benefits. There is also the risk of the facilities becoming underused after the event, leaving the country with a financial burden. Another issue is the potential for disruption to local communities. The influx of tourists can lead to overcrowding and increased traffic, and some residents may be displaced to make way for new construction.

In conclusion, while there are potential benefits to hosting international sports events, such as economic growth and increased national pride, these must be weighed against the potential costs and disruptions. In my opinion, it is important for countries to carefully consider all the factors involved before deciding to host such an event. Perhaps smaller, less expensive events are a more sensible option.
task2.sampleBand7:
International sporting events, such as the Olympics or the FIFA World Cup, are often a source of national pride and excitement. However, there are differing opinions regarding the overall impact of hosting such events. While some argue that they bring numerous benefits to the host country, others believe that the drawbacks outweigh the advantages. This essay will discuss both perspectives before presenting my own opinion.

On the one hand, proponents of hosting international sporting events highlight the potential for economic growth. They argue that these events attract a large influx of tourists, which boosts the hospitality sector and generates revenue for local businesses. Furthermore, the construction of new stadiums and infrastructure can create job opportunities, both during the preparation phase and in the long term. In addition to this, hosting such events can enhance a country's international image, attracting foreign investment and promoting tourism in the years that follow. For example, the 2012 London Olympics is often cited as a success story, bringing significant economic benefits and boosting the UK's global profile.

Conversely, critics argue that the costs associated with hosting international sporting events are often exorbitant and can place a significant burden on taxpayers. The construction of stadiums and other facilities can be extremely expensive, and there is no guarantee that these facilities will be fully utilized after the event. Furthermore, the increased security measures and logistical challenges can disrupt daily life for residents. There are also concerns about the potential for corruption and mismanagement of funds. Some argue that the money could be better spent on other priorities, such as education or healthcare. The experience of some host cities, like Athens after the 2004 Olympics, serves as a cautionary tale of unsustainable spending and long-term debt.

In conclusion, while hosting international sporting events can bring economic benefits and enhance a country's image, it is crucial to weigh these advantages against the potential costs and risks. In my opinion, while the short-term gains can be appealing, the long-term consequences, particularly the financial burden on taxpayers, need to be carefully considered. A thorough cost-benefit analysis and a commitment to responsible financial management are essential to ensure that hosting such an event is truly beneficial for the host country.

Hosting major international sporting events such as the Olympics or the World Cup is often seen as a matter of national pride. However, opinions are divided on whether such events truly benefit the host country. This essay will examine both perspectives before offering my own view.

Supporters of hosting international sports events point to numerous potential benefits. Firstly, such events can boost the economy through increased tourism, as visitors spend money on accommodation, food, and entertainment. The construction of stadiums and infrastructure creates jobs and can lead to lasting improvements in transportation and facilities. Furthermore, the benefits are often unevenly distributed, with local residents sometimes displaced to make way for development while large corporations reap the financial rewards. There are also environmental concerns related to construction and the carbon footprint of international travel.

In my opinion, whether hosting an international sports event is beneficial depends largely on how it is planned and managed. Countries that carefully control costs, build sustainable infrastructure with long-term uses, and ensure benefits are shared broadly can gain from hosting such events. However, those that overspend on temporary structures or neglect the needs of local communities may find the costs outweigh the benefits.

In conclusion, while international sporting events offer potential advantages, careful planning is essential to ensure they truly benefit the host nation.

Ko'pgina davlatlar Olimpiya o'yinlari yoki Jahon chempionati kabi xalqaro sport tadbirlariga mezbonlik qilmoqchi. Ba'zilar buni yaxshi deb hisoblaydi, lekin boshqalar esa yo'q. Ushbu insho har ikki tomon haqida va mening fikrim haqida ham gapiradi.

Bir tomondan, katta sport tadbirining bo'lishi mamlakat uchun yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin. Bu ko'plab sayyohlarni jalb qilishi mumkin va ular mamlakatda pul sarflaydilar. Bu mehmonxonalar va restoranlar kabi korxonalarga yordam beradi. Shuningdek, hukumat yangi stadionlar va yo'llar qurishi mumkin, ulardan tadbir tugaganidan keyin ham odamlar foydalanishi mumkin. Bu ham odamlarni xursand qilishi va o'z mamlakati bilan faxrlantirishi mumkin.

Biroq, bu tadbirlarga mezbonlik qilishda ham muammolar mavjud. Kerak bo'ladigan hamma narsani qurish juda ko'p pulga tushishi mumkin. Ba'zan, hukumat pul qarz olishi kerak bo'ladi va keyin mamlakat qarzdor bo'lib qoladi. Shuningdek, ba'zi odamlar yangi stadionlarga yo'l ochish uchun o'z uylaridan ko'chib ketishlari mumkin. Bu adolatdan emas ular uchun. Xavfsizlik ham juda qattiq bo'lishi kerak, bu esa yanada ko'proq pulga tushadi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, katta sport tadbirlariga mezbonlik qilishning yaxshi va yomon tomonlari bor. Bu pul keltirishi va odamlarni xursand qilishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, bu juda qimmatga tushishi va ba'zi odamlar uchun muammolarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Menimcha, bu mamlakatga bog'liq va ular buni haqiqatan ham qurbi yetadimi yoki yo'qmi. Agar ularning qurbi yetsa, unda bu yaxshi fikr bo'lishi mumkin, lekin agar ularning qurbi yetmasa, buni qilmaslik yaxshiroqdir.

Olimpiya o'yinlari yoki Jahon chempionati kabi xalqaro sport tadbirlariga mezbonlik qilish bahs mavzusi hisoblanadi. Ikkinchidan, bu tadbirlar mamlakatning xalqaro maydondagi obro'sini oshirishi mumkin. Bu chet el investitsiyalarini jalb qilishi va mamlakatning imidjini yaxshilashi mumkin. Nihoyat, bunday tadbirga mezbonlik qilish milliy g'urur va birdamlikni ilhomlantirishi mumkin.
